declarations.description: Process-of-elimination tool for the item in its enclosing `<pie-item-scope>`: it adds a toggle beside each multiple-choice, EBSR and inline-dropdown choice that strikes the choice through or masks it, per `strategy`. It renders nothing of its own and is active while `visible` or `always-on` is set. Eliminations persist in the runtime context's element tool state store, under the key `elementStateKeys` gives each PIE element.
declarations.name: ToolAnswerEliminator

members.name: elementStateKeys
members.description: Store key per PIE element, by model id (JS property only)

attributes.name: elementstatekeys
attributes.description: Store key per PIE element, by model id (JS property only)

cssProperties.name: --pie-answer-eliminator-strike-color
cssProperties.description: Single colour for every part of an elimination: the text line-through, the diagonals over an image, and the line or diagonals over rendered math, so one choice reads as one treatment. Must fall back through canonical --pie-incorrect so a host that themes only the canonical feedback tokens still gets a coherent strike.
